document.abstract: A new breed of premium cinema formats called premium large format (PLF) has recently emerged to enhance the consumer cinema experience. The Dolby Laboratories’ PLF called Dolby Cinema features projectors with dramatically improved dynamic range. In this paper, we explore the impact of room and optics-related factors and assess how these impact the perceived contrast ratio of the images produced by the projector.
